name: HeroMenace
_intent: The villain stops in front of the food: the lead (right) foot plants, the trailing foot takes one slow step, then the head slowly comes up from chin-down to staring straight at the camera, the shoulders roll back, and both fists clench at the sides as the arms flex slightly outward with a small chest lift: a power-up pose, held.
_reference: walk-to-stop, slow look-up, shoulder roll, fist clench (bodybuilder-lite flex); held last pose

keyframes._note: HeroStalk pose at its RIGHT heel strike (t=0.2667)
LOOK: head up, eyes on the camera
POWER: fists clench, arms flex out, chest lifts
